# Third-Party Licenses and Vendored Libraries

All client-side runtime dependencies for **Kurmagram Vedic Village** are vendored locally in `/vendor` to guarantee 100% offline functionality, privacy, and zero external runtime CDN dependencies.

---

### 1. qrcode-generator
- **Repository:** https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- **Version:** 1.4.4
- **License:** MIT License
- **Copyright:** (c) Kazuhiko Arase
- **Purpose:** Client-side generation of NPCI-compliant UPI QR codes with Error Correction Level M.

---

### 2. GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform) & ScrollTrigger
- **Repository:** https://github.com/greensock/GSAP
- **Version:** 3.12.5
- **License:** GreenSock Standard "No-Charge" License (free for commercial and non-commercial websites that don't sell the site itself)
- **Copyright:** (c) GreenSock, Inc.
- **Purpose:** Smooth entrance sequences, scroll-driven storytelling, parallax, and sticky reveals.

---

### 3. Lenis (Darkroom Engineering)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis
- **Version:** 1.1.18
- **License:** MIT License
- **Copyright:** (c) Darkroom Engineering
- **Purpose:** Smooth, momentum-based scrolling synced directly with GSAP ScrollTrigger via single RAF loop.

---

### 4. Fuse.js
- **Repository:** https://github.com/krisk/Fuse
- **Version:** 7.0.0
- **License:** Apache License 2.0
- **Copyright:** (c) Kirollos Risk
- **Purpose:** Client-side bilingual fuzzy search supporting both Telugu script and English phonetic keywords across product names, tags, and descriptions.

---

### 5. canvas-confetti
- **Repository:** https://github.com/catdad/canvas-confetti
- **Version:** 1.9.3
- **License:** MIT License
- **Copyright:** (c) Kiril Vatev
- **Purpose:** Saffron, green, and gold confetti celebration on order submission handoff.

---

### 6. Fonts: Poppins & Noto Sans Telugu
- **Repository:** https://github.com/google/fonts
- **Weights:** 400 (Regular), 600 (Semi-Bold), 700 (Bold)
- **License:** SIL Open Font License (OFL) 1.1
- **Copyright:**
  - Poppins: Copyright (c) 2014-2015 Indian Type Foundry (info@indiantypefoundry.com)
  - Noto Sans Telugu: Copyright 2022 The Noto Project Authors (https://github.com/notofonts/telugu)
- **Format:** Modern `.woff2` Telugu-subset with fallback to system fonts.
